title: Do LLM agents converge on power-seeking in text social environments, as the gridworld theory predicts?

original_idea.body:
# LLM Power-Seeking in Text Social Environments

Text social dilemmas offering power-accumulating vs directly-rewarding options; measure power-seeking choice across sizes/framings.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests whether instrumental-convergence power-seeking transfers to off-the-shelf LLM behavior.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only text social-dilemma scenarios on open models; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused power-seeking-choice measurement; breadth from multiple scenarios/sizes/framings.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected model-organism probe of instrumental convergence, open models, no lab data.

novelty.reasoning: Fine-tuned LLM power-seeking is cited; the off-the-shelf scaling follow-up may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Fine-tuned result exists; off-the-shelf scaling probe may be open.
